meta.siteDescription: Play free online games instantly in your browser. No downloads, no login. New games from indie developers every week on Brainstorming Games.

shell.greetingBody: Pick any game and it starts in your browser. No downloads, no login.

action.name: Action
action.intro: Fast reflexes, close calls and big finishes. Action games throw you straight into the moment: dodge, jump, fight and chase your best run. Every game here starts in your browser in seconds, on a phone or a PC.

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.intro: Explore new worlds one step at a time. Adventure games mix story, discovery and light puzzles, so there is always something around the next corner. Play free, with nothing to install.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.intro: Easy to learn, hard to put down. Arcade games are built for quick sessions and high scores, perfect for a short break. Tap play and chase one more run.

puzzle.name: Puzzle
puzzle.intro: Give your brain a workout. From matching and merging to logic and physics, puzzle games reward a calm head and a clever idea. Play at your own pace, free in your browser.

racing-driving.name: Racing & Driving
racing-driving.intro: Start your engine. Race cars and bikes, drift through corners or just enjoy the drive. These racing and driving games run instantly, with no download.

shooting.name: Shooting
shooting.intro: Take aim and stay sharp. Shooting games test your accuracy and timing across targets, arenas and waves. All of them are suitable for ages 12 and up.

sports.name: Sports
sports.intro: Cricket, football, basketball and more. Sports games bring quick matches and friendly rivalry to your browser. Play a full game in minutes.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.intro: Think two moves ahead. Build, defend, plan and outsmart. Strategy games reward patience and a good plan more than fast fingers.

simulation.name: Simulation
simulation.intro: Run a shop, fly a plane or build a city. Simulation games let you try a role and see what happens when you make the calls.

clicker-idle.name: Clicker & Idle
clicker-idle.intro: Tap, upgrade, repeat. Clicker and idle games grow while you play and keep growing in the background, so every visit has a new upgrade waiting.

io.name: .io
io.intro: Drop into an arena with players from around the world. .io games are simple to start and competitive within seconds.

card-board.name: Card & Board
card-board.intro: Ludo, carrom, chess, solitaire and other table classics. Card and board games are the easiest way to play something familiar, alone or with a friend.

word-trivia.name: Word & Trivia
word-trivia.intro: Find the word, beat the quiz. Word and trivia games are quick, clever and great for learning something new.

2-player.name: 2-Player
2-player.intro: Better with a friend. These games let two people play on the same device or join each other online. Start a party and send the link.

made-in-india.name: Made in India
made-in-india.intro: Games built by studios and solo developers from India. Play something made close to home and support the people who made it.

footer.label: Footer
footer.tagline: Free games. Zero downloads. Play in one tap.

dashboard.noGamesBody: Upload an HTML5 or WebGL build, add covers and a description, and our pre-QA bot checks it in minutes.

wizard.title: Title
wizard.shortDescriptionHint: One sentence for tiles and search results.
wizard.tagsHint: Type a tag and press comma or Enter. At least 3, up to {count}.
wizard.exclusive: Offer a 90-day web-exclusive window after Full Launch (80% share)
wizard.madeInIndiaHint: Show this game in the Made in India collection on the player site.
wizard.controlsHint: Add each thing a player does, then pick the key or touch that does it. At least one.
wizard.more: More for the game page (features, tips, FAQ)
wizard.ownsRights: I made this game or have the rights to publish all of it: code, art, music and sounds.
wizard.noCopies: It is not a copy or clone of another game and does not use other games' names, characters or logos.
wizard.creditsHint: List any assets you did not make (asset packs, fonts, music) and their licence, e.g. "Kenney sprites, CC0".
wizard.checkDetails: Title, short description, category and at least 3 tags
wizard.checkPage: Description and at least one control
wizard.afterSubmit: After you submit, we test-play the game and check it for copied builds, covers, art and text, protected names and harmful code. Clear copies and harmful builds are rejected straight away, with the reason. Then a person on our team plays the game and approves it, usually within 3 working days.
wizard.buildReceived: Build uploaded. After you submit, we test-play it and check it on our side.
wizard.whyNoBuild: No build uploaded yet. Drop your .zip in the box above; it uploads and gets checked by itself.
wizard.whyRunning: The build is still starting its test-play. This ticks by itself in a few seconds.
wizard.whyRejected: This build was rejected. Upload a new one.
wizard.whyRights: Tick both boxes under Rights and originality.
wizard.skillsHint: Pick up to {count}. Players' Brain Profiles grow in these skills when they play your game, and your game shows up for players who want to train them.

media.abBody: Not sure which cover gets more clicks? Upload one or two other versions of your landscape cover. Players see one of them at random, and after each has been shown 1,000 times the cover that more people clicked becomes your main cover automatically. Players just see a normal cover; they never know a test is running.

owner.title: Enter your owner code
owner.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Brainstorming Games.
owner.setupIntro: The management portal needs a second lock that only you hold: a code from an app on your phone.
owner.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
owner.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this code.
owner.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:
owner.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
owner.wrong: That code is not right. Codes change every 30 seconds: try the current one.
owner.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
owner.unavailable: The code could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
owner.note: The portal stays unlocked for this browser session. Never share the code or the set-up key.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.intro: Paid Boosts to fulfil. Make the videos, post them on the official channels, then paste the links here: the studio is e-mailed straight away.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Memberships and Boosts. Razorpay is the record of truth; refunds are made from the Razorpay dashboard.

emails.title: Automated e-mails
emails.intro: Every e-mail the site sent, from the official address. A personal Gmail account sends up to about 100 a day.

autoReview.title: Automatic moderation
autoReview.intro: Runs the moment a game is submitted, before a person looks at it. It compares the build, art and audio files, covers and description with every other studio's games, looks for protected names (also when disguised) and outside ad code, checks the page and the studio's record, and the rights declaration. A person still has to play the game and look at the art before approving.

creators.title: Creators
creators.intro: YouTubers, Reels makers and streamers who share games with their own link and earn 10% of the net ad revenue from the players they bring. Check their channels are real and suitable before approving.
creators.note: Note to the creator (needed to reject or suspend)
creators.payoutsIntro: Creator statements are made in the same monthly revenue run as studio statements. Pay the finalised months below, then record the transfer reference.

liveChanges.title: Changes to live games
liveChanges.intro: Released games whose page text, covers or videos changed. Nothing here is live until you approve it. Decline anything misleading, off-topic or different from the game players will get.
liveChanges.noteHint: Needed to decline (at least a sentence).

boost.title: Boost
boost.intro: Get your game in front of more players. We make short videos of your game and post them on the official Brainstorming Games YouTube and Instagram, and your game gets a sponsored slot on the site.
boost.needLiveBody: A game can be boosted once it has passed review and is live.

boost.hero: First in the homepage spotlight for {count} days
boost.fineprint: Sponsored slots are always marked "Sponsored". A Boost buys reach, not rank: it never changes your game's Brain Rank, which only players' behaviour decides. Videos are posted within 5 working days.
boost.none: You have not boosted a game yet.
boost.videosSoon: Your videos are being made. The links appear here, and we e-mail you.

creators.metaTitle: Creator program: earn by sharing games
creators.title: Share games you love. Earn {pct}% of what your players bring.
creators.intro: Made a Short, a Reel or a stream about a game on Brainstorming Games? Put your creator link in it. Every player who comes through it is yours for 30 days, and you earn a share of the ad revenue they bring, paid monthly.

step1.title: Get your link
step1.body: Apply once. When you are approved, every game has a share link with your handle in it.

step2.title: Post clips
step2.body: Clip gameplay right from the game page, or make a free vertical trailer for any game, with your link on it.

step3.title: Get paid
step3.body: Earn {pct}% of the net ad revenue from players you bring, paid monthly to your bank or UPI from ₹2,000.

creators.signInFirst: Sign in first: your creator account is part of your player account.
creators.adultsOnly: The creator program is for players aged 18 and over, because it pays money.

statusBody.pending: Thanks! We check every channel by hand, usually within 3 working days. We will e-mail you.
statusBody.approved: Your links work now: share games as @{handle}.
statusBody.suspended: Your creator account is suspended. Write to us if you think this is a mistake.

creators.appliedBody: Thanks for applying! We check every channel by hand, usually within 3 working days, and e-mail you the answer.
creators.rejectedBefore: Last time: {note}. You can apply again.

q1.a: Anyone aged 18 or over who makes videos, Reels, posts or streams about games, on any platform, with a real audience of any size.

q2.a: {pct}% of the net ad revenue from players who arrived through your links in the last 30 days. Developers keep their full share: your part comes out of ours.

q3.a: Every month, once your balance reaches ₹2,000 (or $25). Smaller balances roll over to the next month.

q4.q: Can I make videos of any game?
q4.a: Yes, any game on Brainstorming Games. Clips and trailers made here already carry your link.

q5.a: Fake traffic, bots, paid clicks, misleading thumbnails, or asking people to click ads. Earnings from invalid traffic are removed.

apply.title: Apply
apply.handleHint: Your links will look like brainstorming.games/?cr={handle}
apply.badHandle: Handles are 3 to 24 letters, numbers or underscores.
apply.aboutHint: Who watches you and what you make, in a sentence or two.
apply.termsTitle: Key terms of the Creator Agreement

terms.t1: You earn {pct}% of the net ad revenue from players who arrive through your links, for 30 days after their visit.
terms.t2: Payouts are monthly once your balance reaches ₹2,000 or $25; tax is deducted where the law requires.
terms.t3: No fake traffic, bots, paid clicks, or asking people to click ads. Earnings from invalid traffic are removed and the account may be closed.
terms.t4: Label paid or sponsored content as required by the ASCI guidelines, and follow each platform's rules.
terms.t5: You may use game footage, covers and names from Brainstorming Games to promote the games, not to suggest the developers endorse you.
terms.t6: Either side can end the agreement at any time; balances already earned are still paid.

apply.agree: I am 18 or over and accept the Creator Agreement
apply.indiaOnly: The creator program is open to people in India with an Indian bank account.

brain.title: Your Brain Profile
brain.intro: Every game trains skills. As you play, your profile grows in memory, logic, speed, focus and strategy.
brain.signInToKeep: Sign in to keep it on every device
brain.emptyTitle: Your Brain Profile starts with your first game
brain.emptyBody: Play any game that shows the skills it trains. Your profile fills in as you play.
brain.learningIntro: {minutes} minutes of practice in the last 7 days, by skill.
brain.learningChart: Minutes of practice per day for the last 7 days, {minutes} minutes in total.
brain.challengeIntro: Send this link. Your friend sees your profile next to theirs and can try to beat you.
brain.challengeSignIn: Sign in and keep your profile public to get a challenge link.
brain.shareText: Think you can beat my Brain Profile on Brainstorming Games?
brain.reportHint: Every Monday: what you trained last week and how it changed.
brain.howItWorks: How it works: each game's developer tags the skills it trains. Your play time in a game counts for those skills. Scores grow quickly at first and slowly near 100, so a high score takes real practice. Only your own play counts; nothing is shared unless your profile is public.
brain.compareSelf: Your profile, as friends see it
brain.compareIntro: Each skill's score from 0 to 100. Play games that train a skill to raise it.
brain.compareMissing: This player's Brain Profile is private or does not exist.

logic.name: Logic

focus.name: Focus
focus.about: Staying sharp and precise for longer.

verified.intro: A tick next to your studio name on every game and on your studio page, so players know they can trust your games. Cheap on purpose: we want every serious developer to have it.
verified.stateOfficial: Your studio is the house studio: it shows the BS Official badge, and its games are BS Originals.
verified.stateOff: Your studio has no tick yet. Get it below.
verified.stateFounding: Founding studio #{number}: your tick is free until {until}.
verified.benefitTick: The Verified tick next to your studio name on every game page and on your studio page.
verified.benefitReview: Faster review: we promise to review your games within 24 hours instead of 72. If we are late, your next Boost is free.
verified.benefitShelf: Your games can appear in the "From verified studios" row on the home page.
verified.benefitBoost: One free Spotlight Boost every month.
verified.founding: The first {count} studios on Brainstorming Games get the tick free for their first year.
verified.monthBody: 30 days of the tick and all its benefits.
